description: Rehabilitation of road Infrastructure damaged due to the cyclone Ditwah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited, following the national competitive procurement method, for the selection of contractors to rehabilitate and improve several road sections damaged by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committees following the evaluation of the bids so received, the Cabinet approved the proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive lowest bidders, as follows:
